pods.mods.mod.reward_multiplier_info: Multiplies a quest's drops, gold and gems. Dark Memory quests, memoirs, costumes and weapons stay as they are.
pods.mods.mod.shop_unlimited_info: Shop items that restock daily, weekly or monthly never run out. Items with a lifetime limit keep it.
pods.mods.mod.slow_skills_info: Your skills take 50% longer to come back. Rewards ×2.
pods.mods.mod.stamina_free_info: Quests and skips cost no stamina.
pods.mods.mod.stamina_items_to_gold_info: Stamina recovery items you receive arrive as gold instead. Items you already hold stay.
pods.mods.mod.story_friends_info: 2B, 9S, Fio, Lars and others join your friends, cheer you every day and fight with their own costumes in the Arena.
pods.mods.mod.tickets_to_gems_info: Premium summon tickets you receive arrive as free gems instead. Tickets you already hold stay.
pods.mods.mod.unlimited_daily_plays_info: Quests with a daily clear limit can be played as often as you like.
pods.mods.mod.weakness_only_info: Hits that aren't super-effective do half damage. Rewards ×2.
pods.mods.preset.comfort_info: The Comfort Mod's set: its eight mods on, rewards ×10.
pods.mods.preset.everything_info: Every mod on, rewards and EXP ×10. Challenges stay off.
pods.mods.preset.original_info: Every mod off: the game as it was.
pods.mods.saved_next_action: {saved} The mods apply from the game's next action.
pods.mods.title: Mods
pods.mods.title_info: For every player on this device. Mods never change your save and apply without a restart.
